newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Four dead in Taiwan market blaze.
newsitem.headline: Four dead in Taiwan market blaze.

text.p: Fire swept through a traditional market in the Taiwanese capital Taipei on Sunday, killing four people of the same family, police said.
The fire burned most of the wooden market, famous for selling imported goods. Three people were injured, a police officer said by telephone.
The four dead -- Yeh Chung-jen, his wife, and two sons -- were found in their home. Yeh's 64-year-old mother, who was hiding in the toilet, was rescued later.
Another 69-year-old man hid in a water tower for three hours before he was found.
The cause of the fire has not been determined, but local media said shop-owners stored too many goods in the runup to the Chinese lunar new year, blocking fire exits.
The Chinese new year falls on February 7.
